usedFor: Cloudinary stores images and videos, and “Upload Resource” and “Transform Resources” add files and build resized URLs.

bestTemplate.name: “Upload Resource” in Cloudinary
bestTemplate.why: It puts an image, video or raw file into Cloudinary with options like a public ID and folder.

watchOut: “Delete Resources” can delete images or videos by ID, by prefix or all of them, so aim it carefully.
